scope: Bounded batch SfM observation expansion; estimated local surface patch proposals and frozen original-view image corroboration.

experiments.controlled: Supplied slightly inexact finite map; analytic truth only in assertions. Tracking/API experiment, not RGB-only SfM.
experiments.rgbSynthetic: Known K, fresh RGB-derived detector/matcher; estimated initial map; no truth poses/depth in browser reconstruction.
experiments.grahamHall: 12 RGB photographs, cached RGB-derived keypoints/matches, COLMAP-supplied K. Reference poses are evaluator-only; whole baseline-map Sim3 frozen for refinement.
experiments.uploadedVideo: 8s seek, six 10fps analysis frames, manual background mask and crop, assumed K; no geometry reference; no physical speed inferred. Pixels/video remain local.
experiments.evaluation: Same original ownership cohorts and fixed seed gauge; retained/new/lost/split/merge counts separate; no per-frame realignment.
experiments.performance: Single cold software-WebGPU process per mode; selected pipeline stages and logical upload/readback counters. Browser startup/transport and fixture generation excluded; ffmpeg preparation separately recorded. No physical bus/driver/host memory measurement.

otherChecks: RGB hashes/controls/baseline counts identical between ablations; expected fixed-seed registration and finite-depth deferral
Cache/stateless cohort and support-count equality, empty cache and zero device live bytes

defaults.reason: Controlled patch and some synthetic metrics improve; real-photo accuracy does not improve and corroboration adds substantial latency. Cache cuts uploads but does not offset added work.

remainingLimits: No full-clip automatic masks/cuts or observation archive
No claim that corroboration verifies physical point identity or rejects all repeated assets
Sparse/noisy/curved/occluded surfaces may defer or mislead patch proposals; original image and mapper geometry checks remain necessary
Original two-view-only tracks retain unavailable corroboration, not fabricated third evidence or depth
No rigid/deformable object reconstruction or dynamic Radiance pipeline
Current PR222/223 heads were not combined in this phase
Remote CI status is separate from local evidence
